posts.text:
Republican leadership is too afraid of Trump to fulfill their constitutional duties. 

Congress has an obligation to provide real oversight. I will keep fighting to stop this war and demand accountability from the Trump administration.

Video

This is the reality our families are facing at the pump—no matter what spin comes from the Trump administration. Americans are hurting.

Video

It’s too hard for working families to get ahead in today’s America. I've proposed eliminating the tax avoidance mechanisms of the ultra wealthy and using that savings to raise the standard deduction for families to 75 k and significantly expanding the Child tax Credit and Earned Income Tax Credit. This would make our tax system more fair and let working families keep much more of their earnings.

Video

We don’t know the full extent of the Trump family’s corruption. 

The GOP-controlled Congress has let them walk away with hundreds of millions. No hearings, no accountability, no checks or balances.

Video

Kindness is action. Kindness is showing up. Kindness is stepping forward and serving others in ways big and small.

Video

This isn't left vs. right—it's right vs. wrong.

Big corporations and their lobbyists have captured both parties, putting profits over our families' health. I've fought Monsanto and Bayer for years, and just filed an amicus brief to the Supreme Court to protect our right to sue them for illnesses caused by their products.

Video

Firing all 24 members of the National Science Board undermines our nation, the objectivity of science, the independence of researchers, and the strength that has fueled so much American strength.

Video

On this, my birthday…

I thank God for a year, though with more challenges than victories, that taught me lessons hidden in pain, in loss, in struggle.

For showing me that taking a noble stand, even if it costs you, even when you’re criticized, is far better than living safe, silent, and untested.

I Thank God for a year that built grit in so many of us and taught us more about the invincible power of not giving up.

For the humbling truth that no one person can save the world but we all can se

Random acts of kindness.
A shoulder to lean on.
A hand to help someone up.
Strength offered to someone feeling weak.

Today, you may not be able to change the whole world.

But you can make a world of difference to someone.

And sometimes, that is the world begins of bigger changes to come.

Video

Trump's unqualified cabinet is costing all Americans

Video

Never forget, this world is filled with heroes.

Villains may dominate the headlines, but they do not define us.

There are far more people choosing kindness, showing courage, offering grace, and doing quiet good every single day.

Don’t let the noise make you forget that.
Don’t let it make you cynical.

And most of all, be one of the people who reminds others of the decency in this world - 

Through your actions.
Through your words.
Through how you show up for others in need.

Video

Trump's policies are a shameful disgrace

Video

The American people are tired of the Trump administration's reckless policies that divide us, endanger our future, and betray our nation.

Video

Everything comes in waves.

Nothing lasts forever.

Storms rise… and storms recede.

So when you feel battered and bruised, remember:

this too shall pass.

Hold fast.

Because tides turn.
Winds shift.

And those fighters, who refuse to let go, who keep rowing through the rough waters,
are the ones who reach open skies,
new horizons,
and waves not of struggle…
but of possibility.

I promise. 

Don't give up. 

A wave of hope is coming.

Video
